Title: The Sisters and Their Cat
Content: Sofia and her sister, Rosa, wanted a cat for a long time. They kept asking their mom and dad to adopt one. One day, their parents brought home a new cat for them. They were so excited and loved the cat. They could not wait to teach the cat many new things. The two sisters and their cat had many fun adventures.
